name: Transcribe + translate to English
description: Transcribes speech in any language and writes an English transcript and subtitles in the same pass (whisper's own translation, no second model).

models.purpose: whisper.cpp ggml large-v3 q5_0 (quantised, CPU inference)

parameters.label: Audio file (absolute path inside the project)
Whisper model
parameters.description: small: ~2.2x realtime, mis-hears Russian. large-v3-q5_0: ~0.4x realtime, gets the words right.

notes: whisper-cli on the host CPU, no VRAM. large-v3-q5_0 costs ~4x the wall time of small and ~1 GiB of disk, and is the difference between plausible-sounding nonsense and an accurate transcript for accents and non-English speech.
